Excellent! A white precipitate formed when I added Ba(NO3)2 to the sample. This is very informative:

If the anion were NO3-:

If the anion were F-:

Additionally, the pH of 8 (slightly basic) also supports this conclusion, as F- hydrolyzes in water to produce OH- ions, making the solution basic.

Therefore, the anion in the sample is F- (fluoride), and the original salt is AgF (silver fluoride).
